_comment: Hand-authored METADATA for each playable character — everything true about a character that cannot be derived from the PixelLab art. `lore` is only the first field; add more (tags, hometown, starting class, voice, …) as records grow. Keyed by the character's humans/<id> folder id. Authored HERE and merged onto humans/<id>/character.json by sync.py, because that file is regenerated on every sync and would otherwise wipe it — so consumers may read either this file or the merged fields on character.json.
_maintenance: Edit fields HERE, never in humans/<id>/character.json (generated). New character: add a record under `characters` keyed by its folder id. Every field is optional — absent fields are simply omitted downstream, so adding one never breaks a consumer.

default_boy.lore: A young man of the human race — no claws, no scales, no magic in the blood, just nerve and a quick pair of hands. He sets out with nothing but what he stands in.

default_girl.lore: A young woman of the human race, level-headed and hard to rattle. She carries no blade yet, only the stubborn confidence that carried humankind this far.
